payload.title: cart badge count updates after adding an item
payload.errorMessage:
expect(locator).toHaveText(expected) failed

Locator: getByTestId('cart-count-badge')
Expected: "3"
Received: "2"

note: A badge showing one less than expected reads like an off-by-one cart bug, but the UI optimistically increments the badge locally then reconciles against the server's cart-total response; the assertion sometimes fires between the optimistic paint and the reconcile. Retried-then-passed plus a meaningfully high 17.5% historical rate confined to this one assertion (not the whole cart flow) point to a UI-only race, not a broken increment.
